old.data_flow_description: Loads the browser-targeted 1DS telemetry appender module for sending telemetry from browser-hosted (renderer) code.

flow.claim: src/vs imports the browser build of the 1DS telemetry appender (1dsAppender.js) to transport telemetry from renderer-side code.

why.claim: The browser/renderer process needs a browser-safe telemetry transport (no Node APIs), verified directly by 1dsAppender.test.ts.
